tools.name: mandate.mint
tools.description: Creates an active human-granted mandate for an agent and records it to the hash-chained ledger.

tools.name: mandate.delegate
tools.description: Creates a child mandate only when it is a no-escalation subset of the parent mandate.

tools.name: mandate.authorize-action
tools.description: Submits an action through the Gateway and canonical Policy Engine; returns ALLOW, DENY, or REQUIRE_APPROVAL with ledger proof.

tools.name: mandate.verify-proof
tools.description: Records a proof payload hash and appends proof evidence to the hash-chained ledger.

tools.name: mandate.revoke
tools.description: Revokes a mandate subtree and records the revocation to the hash-chained ledger.

tools.name: broker.register-credential
tools.description: Registers an opaque vault handle/reference only; plaintext secret fields are rejected and never ledgered.

tools.name: broker.request-access
tools.description: Asks the canonical Policy Engine for an ALLOW decision before issuing a short-lived HMAC-sealed grant bound to credential, mandate, agent, scope, and expiry.

tools.name: broker.use
tools.description: Redeems a sealed grant for the bound acting agent and executes the bound action through the Gateway and Policy Engine; does not expose plaintext secrets.

tools.name: broker.revoke-grant
tools.description: Revokes a broker grant by id and records the revocation to the ledger.

tools.name: broker.introspect-grant
tools.description: Validates a grant token seal, reports active/revoked/expired state, and records introspection to the ledger.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "broker.register-credential" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
